copy.lede: Dave the Handyman takes on everything from putting up a basketball hoop that's been waiting a year to fixing wobbly fence posts and refreshing tired bathrooms and kitchens around Shoreham-by-Sea. Customers say he's prompt, precise, tidy and reasonably priced.
copy.about_alt: A refreshed bathroom with grey tiles and a new shower screen, by Dave the Handyman

steps.text: Damp, stained flooring and boxing round the toilet.
